name: Bracers of Binding
summary: In Tarren Mill, Keeper Bel'varil looks ahead to what the Magus may need next. The Magus studies the stone tokens you gathered, and Bel'varil sends you to the ruins of Dalaran for four Bracers of Earth Binding.

sections.title: Bracers of Earth Binding
sections.body: As the Magus studies the stone tokens you gathered, Keeper Bel'varil expects another need to follow. Bracers of binding are worn on an elemental's wrists, where they bind the creature to a mage's service. Elementals wear them among the ruins of Dalaran. Bel'varil wants you to bring four Bracers of Earth Binding back to Tarren Mill.

faq.answer: Keeper Bel'varil in Tarren Mill gives it to you after you gathered the stone tokens.

faq.q: What are the bracers used for?
aliases: what do bracers of binding do
faq.answer: Bracers of binding are worn on an elemental's wrists to bind it to a mage's service.
You find the elementals in the ruins of Dalaran, in the Alterac Mountains.

faq.q: Why does Keeper Bel'varil want them?
faq.answer: Bel'varil expects the Magus will eventually want examples of the bracers, which are the counterpart to the stone tokens the Magus is studying.
Before this, you gathered the stone tokens in Stone Tokens. The Magus is now studying them.
